subject: Request: temporary capacity consolidation + freeze exception for inference-serving Q1 planning
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: temporary capacity consolidation + freeze exception for inference-serving Q1 planning

Hi team,

Quick summary: one of our senior inference infra engineers (IC-4 on the serving team) has decided to leave effective 12/18. Hiring is currently frozen for open HC in Eng, but this role is critical to maintain our dedicated capacity SLAs for a high-volume enterprise customer (do not want to name externally here).

I ran a short impact model (attached Q1_capacity_impact.xlsx) and a low-friction temporary consolidation plan (proposed_temp_ramp.docx). My ask: approve a 10-12 week freeze-exception so we can reallocate two 0.4 FTEs from adjacent squads + a short-term contractor to cover on-call and critical rollouts. This reduces immediate hiring spend and gives us runway to triage whether to refill, repurpose, or deprioritize the capacity.

What I need from you today:
- Laura: sign off on the exception threshold (I recommend up to 12 weeks).
- Mina: confirm whether People Ops can start the exception form + expedite a contract for a contractor.
- Connor: confirm that adjacent squads can absorb 0.4 FTE each and a proposed on-call rotation.

Risks I flagged: potential slippage on two customer rollouts in Jan if we under-resource; increased on-call fatigue for the two teams taking the split coverage. Mitigations in the docs.

I can be on a call at 11:00 if you want to run the numbers live.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q1_capacity_impact.xlsx (spreadsheet), proposed_temp_ramp.docx (doc)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: temporary capacity consolidation + freeze exception for inference-serving Q1 planning

Marissa —

Thanks for the concise plan and the model. I support a conditional exception for up to 12 weeks provided we get the following commitments:
1) A documented on-call rotation and escalation matrix before 12/18.
2) Weekly check-ins (15m) with me for the first 6 weeks to monitor SLAs.
3) Clear owner for the contractor scope and a sunset plan with milestones.

If those three boxes are checked, I approve the exception. Mina — please confirm the process for the form and expected lead time. Connor — can you confirm the rotation proposed?

—Laura
Laura Bennett
VP Engineering, Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 13:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: temporary capacity consolidation + freeze exception for inference-serving Q1 planning

Laura / Marissa —

I reviewed the proposed_temp_ramp.docx. The adjacent teams can each absorb ~0.35-0.45 FTE for the first 8 weeks; beyond that we should re-evaluate. I can put together the on-call rotation and escalation matrix by EOD today and share the calendar invites for the weekly 15m check-ins.

Note for finance: there will be a small contractor cost (~$18k over 10 weeks) and potential overtime budget shifts. Marissa — can you loop Finance Approvals (fin-approvals@redwood-corp.com) so we can get that part greenlit? I'll forward the cost line items.

On the contractor: I'd prefer the vendor HiringOps (talent-ops@acme-recruiting.com) we used in Q2; they gave us a 3-week SLA last time.

Connor
Eng Manager, Serving Operations

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: temporary capacity consolidation + freeze exception for inference-serving Q1 planning

Thanks — Mina from People Ops here. We can support an expedited freeze-exception. Next steps from People Ops:
- Please complete the attached freeze_exception_form.pdf and list the specific HC lines to be reallocated.
- We will need sign-off from Finance Approvals for contractor spend; recommend getting the PO raised concurrently.
- We can ping HiringOps to stand up the contractor search (3-week SLA) but will not open a permanent HC requisition until the exception is approved.

Document note: When completing the form, include expected sunset date (today's recommendation: 2027-02-28) and measurable success criteria (no SLA degradation, <2 critical incidents tied to capacity).

I'll start the exception workflow once the form is back — aim to have approvals in 48–72 hours if Finance is aligned.

Mina Haddad
Senior People Partner, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: temporary capacity consolidation + freeze exception for inference-serving Q1 planning

All —

Thanks for the quick responses and for the conditional approval, Laura. I've completed the freeze_exception_form.pdf (attached) with the 2027-02-28 sunset and the success criteria Mina specified. Connor — attaching the on-call rotation draft to this thread; please review and confirm before EOD.

Action items:
- Connor: finalize rotation and send calendar invites (by EOD 12/01).
- Mina: start People Ops workflow and route to Finance Approvals.
- Marissa (me): raise the PO for the contractor pending Finance confirmation; I'll also book the weekly 15m check-ins.

I'll loop in Finance Approvals and HiringOps in a separate message to keep HR thread internal.

Cheers,
Marissa
